name: tester
description: On-demand manual verification of a running app by an agent. One command discovers the live stack, builds an ephemeral environment brief, derives test suites from a spec's acceptance criteria (or from the git diff when no spec is given), and fans out one subagent per suite across three surfaces — curl for API, agent-browser for UI, and fault-injection (dependency pause/stop or a WireMock proxy) for error handling. Every suite returns only an evidence-backed PASS/FAIL table under a hard assertion contract; the main thread triages genuine failures into impl/test/spec defects. No config, no persisted plan, no staleness tracking — the light counterpart to the mt plugin. User-run only.
